text:
alex: Quick sync 1 CloudOrbit wants a marketplace-friendly Terraform quickstart + module that wires up a minimal inference fleet to our Dedicated runtime. Must support: NLB, autoscaling (scale on CPU and queue length), optional GPU nodepool, and an MRT (mutual TLS) toggle for controller calls. Theyd like a tiny Node sample that hits the Redwood API and shows region override headers.

sophie: I can spin up the module repo. Proposal: `modules/cloudorbit-inference` with interface: region, vpc_id, subnet_ids, public_ingress, node_pool = {count, instance_type, gpu}, enable_mtls, log_sink_s3. We'll include an examples/quickstart and a minimal app under examples/sample-app.

raj: On CI: prefer Terratest for acceptance but keep GH Actions matrix that also runs `terraform validate`, `tflint`, and `checkov` for infra security checks. For smoke runs we'll use a mocked Redwood endpoint and a lightweight runner to validate LB and autoscale triggers.

tina: Security asks for explicit outbound CIDR allowlist, KMS key option for node disk encryption, and least-privilege policy for instance role. Also need a short section on data residency and customer-managed logs for marketplace listing.

partner-rep: Good list. Legal also asked for a one-line blurb about data handling in the quickstart README. We'll provide a sample test key and a model artifact URL for the demo.

alex: For the marketplace checklist we need: 1) module + README with architecture diagram, 2) one-click deploy example (cloudinit + user-data), 3) automated PR checks, 4) example app screenshot + curl snippet. Who owns diagram?

sophie: I'll create a simple SVG diagram and an ASCII fallback. I can also add a minimal `architecture.md` explaining components and failure modes (NLB, nodepool, autoscaler, model store).

raj: Tests: unit terraform fmt/lint; integration smoke that asserts NLB has healthy targets and sample-app receives 200 from mocked infer endpoint. Long-run integration with real GPUs can be scheduled with infra for a 1hr window after partner sign-off.

tina: Adding variables: `use_market_image` (bool), `partner_image` (string), `kms_key_arn`, `egress_cidrs`. Outputs: `nlb_dns`, `node_role_arn`, `autoscaler_policy_id`.

alex: Tiny README snippet for marketing screenshots:

```terraform
module "cloudorbit_inference" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/partner-modules/cloudorbit-inference"
  region = "eu-west-1"
  vpc_id = "vpc-0abc"
  subnet_ids = ["subnet-111","subnet-222"]
  node_pool = { count = 2, instance_type = "g4dn.xlarge", gpu = true }
  use_market_image = true
}
```

partner-rep: Sample curl well use in demo: `curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" -H \"X-Region: eu-west-1\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -d '{"input":"hello"}'`

mkt-bot: Created ticket partners/marketplace-connector #981: "cloudorbit terraform quickstart" (assignee: sophie).

alex: Timeline suggestion: skeleton repo + PR by Thu, CI green by next Mon, partner review Tue, docs + diagram by Wed, demo Fri. If anyone needs to move dates, call it out.

sophie: Will open repo tonight and link PR here. I might need help from tina for IAM policy snippets.

raj: FYI I'll add a lightweight test harness in `tests/smoke` that can be run locally or in GH Actions. It will mock infer and validate LB + auto-scale logic.

tina: I'll draft the least-privilege role JSON and paste into the repo under `examples/iam`.

partner-rep: Thanks all 1 we'll prep test key + model artifact and confirm time for the Friday demo.

alex: Ok action items: sophie = module + README + diagram; raj = CI + terratest harness; tina = security policy + outputs; partner-rep = test artifacts; alex = schedule demo + coordinate review. :ok_hand:
